## Checklist

- [ ] One change: anything unrelated is in its own pull request.
- [ ] A bug fix has a check in `tests/storybook.spec.mjs` that fails on `main` and passes here.
- [ ] `npm run build-storybook` and `npm run test:storybook` pass.
- [ ] Looked at in Ink, Paper and Snow, at desktop and phone widths, and with reduced motion.
- [ ] The README section and the story are updated, for a change an app can see.
- [ ] Says so here if it renames or changes a class, a token, a `data-` attribute, a hook or one of the canonical choices.
- [ ] No changes to the version in `package.json` or the README's install tags (the maintainers keep those).
